The '''Siskeen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]].

==Description==
One of the system's [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|191|Kaer Orbital Platform}}</ref> [[Kaer]], held the [[Kaer Orbital Platform]] and the [[Kaer Station]] that was later used as a base and headquarters by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]].<ref name="SWL37" /> It also contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]]<ref name="SWR:T" /> and [[Olanet]].<ref name="O" />

==History==
The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Early in the conflict, the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] built the [[Kaer Orbital Platform]].<ref name="GB:CC-DB" /> It was [[Battle of Kaer Orbital Platform|taken]] by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Jor Drakas]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="GB:CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Legacy (2006) 37|''Legacy'' (2006) 37]], Siskeen system is erroneously placed into [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].
